denominator_scope: all agricultural land-use classes in ALLland categories
numerator_scope: all farm categories, entire sown area under harvest2021
method: regional primary-statistics pair sameyear; snapshotend2021; no old2008denominator; no municipal allocation
ratio_limitation: Sown area measures annual crops only, excludes permanent plantations, haymaking and grazing; denominator includes arable,fallow,perennials,hayfields,pasture. Therefore low ratio alone is not abandonment or inefficiency.
